summary: Iteration 7 frontend testing complete. All 5 bottom tabs render (tab-home/program/plans/history/progress). Programme tab empty state shows both CTAs. /programs modal shows CRÉER MON PROGRAMME dashed card + PROGRAMMES INCLUS (3 bundled). Custom program editor works end-to-end: meta fields, level chips, emoji/color picker, duration +/- resizes day list, day picker chips, toggle-rest flips to SÉANCE, add-session creates a 2nd session on same day with sess-label-0/1 and sess-title-0/1 fields, save-cp persists. Saved custom program appears under MES PROGRAMMES with PERSO tag. Starting bundled fullbody-30 makes Home show today-session-0 with start-today-0 button, and Programme tab renders active hero + upcoming-1-session-0 pressables. No red screen, no crashes, migration path from legacy completedDayIndexes present in gym-storage.normalizeActive.
